title: TMNT The Last Ronin Action Figure Playmates 2025 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle NIB
descriptionText:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Last Ronin action figure by Playmates Toys (2025, item #81205), new and unopened in the original box with all accessories: katana, staff, nunchucks, sai, shuriken and more.

Condition: New, never opened. The box shows light shelf wear on the edges. Please review all photos - they are of the actual item you will receive.
